description: The ten Aquaculture Opportunity Areas (AOAs) NOAA identified in federal waters off Southern California (decision signed 2025-09-10, identified 2025-09-19) in two study areas (North, Central North). Source is the NOAA Fisheries shapefile (NAD83(2011) / California Albers), reprojected to EPSG:4326. `AOA` is the area code (e.g. N1-A, CN1-B). Built by catalog/build_erin_layers.py from 1 source layer(s).
